sn10.6:1.1: On one occasion the Venerable Anuruddha was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Park.
sn10.6:1.2: Now on that occasion the Venerable Anuruddha, having risen at the first flush of dawn, was reciting stanzas of Dhamma.
sn10.6:1.3: Then the female yakkha Piyaṅkara’s Mother hushed her little child thus:
sn10.6:2.4: We might practise for our welfare.
sn10.6:3.1: “Let us refrain from harming living beings,
sn10.6:3.2: Let us not speak a deliberate lie,
sn10.6:3.3: We should train ourselves in virtue:
sn10.6:3.4: Perhaps we’ll be freed from the goblin realm.”
